exposure: Placental T2* values (indirect measure of placental oxygenation)
outcome: Birth outcomes (specifically, likelihood of operative vaginal birth or emergency caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 29 women in their late third trimester.
finding: It was feasible to obtain comprehensive maternal pelvimetry, fetal biometry, and placental oxygenation measures from a single late gestation MRI examination, demonstrating generally excellent intra-rater variability and moderate to excellent inter-rater reliability.
mod_finding: While this pilot study focused on the feasibility of an MRI protocol, its aim was to better inform the likelihood of operative vaginal birth or emergency caesarean section, and the authors suggest it could be used in future studies to predict assisted birth or caesarean section.
